authority.protocol: Current main8f7f guest engines; native before/after source-bound runners differ. Same frozen eeba68033 filesystem corpus, targetRC1; bump parent/worker and RC coordinator. Three cold/warm rounds, reversed pair order, equal-length lane/cache/output paths, fresh private guest caches, native JIT primed on another input, no overlapping builds/profiles. Ordinary, same-driver serial, process workers1/2/4, ordinary identical-before A/A controls. Whole public frontend wall and simultaneous process-tree RSS20ms.
